description: The map's messages: the keys by message number from "first" (the numbers before it are common.json's), and the English text of the original game.

strings.map1_s00.10_00_alchemy_laboratory_gold:
{pos 4}{center}{color 3}10:00
[Alchemy laboratory]

Gold in an old man's palm.
The future hidden in his fist.
Exchange for sage's water.{end}
strings.map1_s00.12_00_a_place_with:
{pos 4}{center}{color 3}12:00
[A place with songs and sound]

A silver guidepost is
untapped in lost tongues.
Awakening at the ordained order.{end}
strings.map1_s00.5_00_darkness_that_brings:
{pos 4}{center}{color 3}5:00
[Darkness that brings
the choking heat]

Flames render the silence,
awakening the hungry beast.
Open time's door to beckon prey.{end}
strings.map1_s00.cheryl_might_be_here_i:
Cheryl might be here.
I should search for her.{end}
strings.map1_s00.i_dont_know_who_drew:
I don't know who drew it,
but it is certainly in bad taste.{end}
strings.map1_s00.there_is_a_switch_do:
There is a switch.
Do you want to press the switch?{choice 4}
strings.map1_s00.the_valve_is_tightly_shut:
The valve is tightly shut.
Can't move it.
strings.map1_s00.dont_know_what_it_is:
Don't know what it is for,
better leave it alone.{end}
strings.map1_s00.nothing_useful_in_the_desk:
Nothing useful
in the desk drawer.{end}
strings.map1_s00.moore_ranaldo_gordon_this_must:
Moore, Ranaldo, Gordon...
This must be the list of teachers.{end}
